Part 2 · Extended Discussion
1Do you think handwritten letters will be common in the future?✓ written
Model answer

I don’t think so. Messages are faster and easier. Only some people will write letters because they feel special.

I don't think so. Since digital communication is so convenient, letters will probably become rare, kept mainly by people who see them as something special. For most people, a quick message will always be easier than writing by hand.

YOUR ANSWER
2What are the advantages of electronic communication?✓ written
Model answer

It’s fast and cheap. You can talk to people far away and even see them on a video call. It really helps families who live in different places.

It's fast, cheap, and lets you stay in touch with people no matter the distance. You can also send photos or make a video call, which wasn't possible in the past. This makes it much easier to keep strong relationships even when people live far apart.

YOUR ANSWER

Model answer

Yes, I think so. A lot of people feel nervous without their phone. I think we should take a break from our devices sometimes.

YOUR ANSWER

Model answer

I think it’s very important. Students can find information quickly and watch videos to learn. They can also take online courses or practice English with apps.

I think the Internet plays a very important role in education because it gives students quick access to a huge amount of information. It also makes learning more flexible and interactive. For example, students can watch educational videos, attend online courses, use digital libraries, or practice languages with different apps and websites.
